quote: Must provide
reason: Template capability-contract structure; no oracle policy requires an implementation to ship enforcement data, command facets or knowledge skills, or defines conformance of instruction modules.
specific_behavior: A replacement test-framework module without an enforcement adapter or commands facet is non-conformant and must be raised as a Decision Request rather than shipped.

quote: Placement belongs to the frame; technique belongs to the leaf.
reason: Instruction-authoring vocabulary rule of the L1 capability design; no oracle policy restricts which technology names may appear in which instruction files.
specific_behavior: A workflow edit that writes 'run the NUnit tests' or 'update the EF Core mapping' outside the owning module is a leak and is flagged by the instruction checker.

quote: Placement belongs to the frame; technique belongs to the leaf.
reason: Template-structure ownership rule; the oracle prescribes no ownership location for instruction content.
specific_behavior: Maintenance must put test-project placement in the frame and framework technique in the backend-testing module, and an undeclared leaf-to-frame binding is non-conformant.

quote: Changing the frame is Reserved and requires an ADR
reason: ARC-020/DEP-002/GOV-017 require explicit approval for replacing approved technology but no oracle policy requires an ADR artifact for the change.
specific_behavior: After the user approves replacing NUnit, the change is still incomplete until an ADR is written.

quote: Replace all four facets together
reason: Template maintenance procedure of the capability model; no oracle policy governs how instruction files change when a technology is replaced or removed.
specific_behavior: Replacing the test framework by editing only the commands facet, or removing Angular without clearing the selection row and import, is non-conformant.

quote: Provider variant, default string-comparison/case-sensitivity semantics, migration mechanism, seeding mechanism.
reason: ARC-020 requires approval for new persistence technology and GOV-006 for observable string semantics, but no oracle policy requires preserving migration/seeding mechanisms or maintaining a declared-property record when persistence changes.
specific_behavior: A proposal to replace EF Core with Dapper that omits how migrations and seeding work is non-conformant even if approved.

quote: When the schema changes, add a migration
reason: The oracle requires a migration only for schema-affecting CUSTOM_SETTINGS changes (PST-009) and review of generated migrations (PST-010); it has no general duty to pair every schema change with a migration or to confirm schema impact at stop time.
specific_behavior: Editing a Domain entity without a migration blocks the stop once until the agent confirms whether the schema changed.

quote: Report model changes, migration names with review notes
reason: WF-009 requires reporting the actual verification state; it does not prescribe persistence-specific report contents.
specific_behavior: A persistence change summary that omits migration review notes or the seeder status does not satisfy the workflow.

quote: "reason": "deprecated sink package; use Elastic.Serilog.Sinks"
reason: DEP-004 requires checking deprecation and DEP-020 treats direct Polly integration as an explicit exception, but no oracle policy forbids specific packages outright regardless of approval.
specific_behavior: Adding FluentValidation.AspNetCore or Microsoft.Extensions.Http.Polly produces 'must not be added' feedback even when the user requested it.

quote: Dependency change detected. Run the add-dependency workflow first
reason: DEP-001..DEP-005 govern additions and updates; no oracle policy routes dependency removals through a workflow gate.
specific_behavior: 'npm uninstall lodash' requested by the user is denied on first attempt; the agent must go through add-dependency and re-run the command.

quote: a Reserved decision unless it implements the approved layout
reason: ARC-020 requires approval for new layers/projects and ARC-001 constrains direction; no oracle policy makes individual reference edges between existing projects (including direction-legal edges outside the documented layout) Reserved, nor requires confirmation of each reference command.
specific_behavior: A direction-legal Api -> Domain reference needs approval, and even standard layout reference commands stop for user confirmation.

quote: Conformance dependencies point only to the same or a more stable level; Core and Architecture name no concrete implementation technology in any form
reason: Instruction-system organization rule of the L1 template; the oracle defines no level hierarchy, header format or technology-neutrality requirement for instruction files.
specific_behavior: Adding a sentence naming EF Core or a pointer '(technique: ef-core)' to a Core rule fails the checker and must be moved to a Level 2 facet.

quote: only the four slots
reason: No oracle policy defines capability slots, their cardinality or a selection record; ARC-020/DEP-009 only fix the approved stack and require approval to change it.
specific_behavior: A maintainer may not add a fifth slot (e.g. logging), keep two persistence implementations, or ship an unselected module.

quote: the critical PreToolUse gate sets `onFailure: "block"`; post and Stop hooks stay non-blocking
reason: Hook-configuration design of the template; no oracle policy regulates how instruction-system hooks are registered or how they fail.
specific_behavior: Registering a hook as a shell command string, or making the post hook blocking, violates the template contract and fails the checker.

quote: commit `package.json` and `package-lock.json`, keep the lockfile consistent
reason: Read as a version-control content convention (both files belong in the repository) the clause is entailed by DEP-007; read as an instruction to perform commits it conflicts with GOV-015, which allows commits only on explicit request. The text does not resolve which reading is meant.
specific_behavior: Under the commit reading an agent could commit lockfile changes without an explicit request; under the convention reading it only must not ignore or omit the lockfile.

quote: required skill is missing
reason: Inventory and invocation invariants of the template; no oracle policy requires particular skills to exist or fixes their invocation mode.
specific_behavior: Deleting the docker skill, making verify user-only, or citing another skill's private reference fails the checker.

quote: do not leave dead references
reason: DEP-001 restricts adding dependencies and GOV-014 limits scope; no oracle policy requires removing dependencies made unused by a change.
specific_behavior: A refactor that stops using a package must also remove its PackageReference/package.json entry.

quote: Package, version, license, vulnerability/deprecation result, target project, and approvals obtained or still pending.
reason: WF-009 covers verification reporting; no oracle policy prescribes dependency-specific report contents.
specific_behavior: A dependency addition reported without its license and vulnerability result does not satisfy the workflow.

quote: adopting versioning is Reserved
reason: API-013 allows introducing versioning when a real compatibility need exists and does not require approval; the oracle's consequential-change list does not name API versioning adoption.
specific_behavior: With published clients needing coexistence, the agent must still send a Decision Request before adding versioning.

quote: Write an ADR at `docs/decisions/NNNN-<kebab-title>.md`
reason: GOV-017 requires approval for Reserved changes but no recording artifact; GOV-007 covers product behavior sources only. No oracle policy requires ADR documents or level-stratified decision summaries.
specific_behavior: After the user approves adopting Mapster for a new area, the agent must also write an ADR and a decision summary line.

quote: Decision, ADR path, decision files updated, follow-up work
reason: No oracle policy prescribes decision-recording report contents.
specific_behavior: A recorded decision reported without its ADR path is incomplete.

quote: Register validators with `FluentValidation.DependencyInjectionExtensions`
reason: DEP-010 fixes FluentValidation as the library and API-010 the validation boundaries; no oracle policy prescribes the registration package.
specific_behavior: Registering validators by hand-written assembly scanning or another DI package deviates from the instruction.

quote: Backend build: PASS / NOT RUN / NOT APPLICABLE
reason: WF-009 requires reporting actual verification states; it does not prescribe failure/root-cause/change sections.
specific_behavior: A repair summary without root cause or changes made does not satisfy the workflow.

quote: caching tracked ORM entities across commit boundaries
reason: RUN-021 governs invalidation consistency and ARC-019 confines the ORM to the implementation layer; caching tracked entities is an ORM technique pitfall (EXC-011 class) that the template elevates to a named prohibition.
specific_behavior: An adapter caching tracked entity instances for reuse in later use cases violates the instruction even with correct invalidation.

quote: **Critical** — data loss, security vulnerability, reliably broken core behavior
reason: WF-011/WF-012 prescribe priorities and no manufactured findings; the oracle sets no output format or severity scale.
specific_behavior: A review listing findings without severity or proposed fix does not meet the procedure.

quote: Report the setting, old → new value, every surface updated, and the `verify` result.
reason: No oracle policy prescribes settings-change report contents.
specific_behavior: A settings change report that omits the updated surfaces is incomplete.

quote: Treat `main`, `master`, and other protected or shared branches as non-rewritable.
reason: GOV-015 allows repository-changing Git operations only on explicit request; the alternative trigger 'required by an approved workflow' names no such workflow and could authorize high-risk operations without an explicit request, or could merely refer to an explicitly approved procedure. The relation to GOV-015 cannot be settled from the text.
specific_behavior: Under the broad reading an agent could force-push or delete a branch because a workflow 'requires' it, without the user's explicit request.

quote: Summarize what changed, Delegated decisions taken, open Decision Requests (Reserved), and the `verify` report.
reason: WF-009 covers verification state and GOV-017 reporting of unresolved Decision Requests in headless runs; listing Delegated decisions in every implementation summary is an additional reporting duty.
specific_behavior: A final summary that omits the Delegated decisions taken does not follow the workflow.

quote: Treat `main`, `master`, and other protected or shared branches as non-rewritable.
reason: GOV-015 permits repository-changing operations, including force-push and rebase, when explicitly requested; this rule forbids rewriting these branches without an approval path.
specific_behavior: Even when the user explicitly asks to force-push a rewritten main, the instruction tells the agent not to rewrite it.

quote: Never claim checks that were not run.
reason: No oracle policy prescribes PR description contents; WF-009 only requires truthful verification reporting.
specific_behavior: A PR prepared without verification or migration notes does not follow the workflow.

quote: Do not wrap normal ORM operations in a generic application-level retry pipeline
reason: RUN-016 governs when retries are safe and the oracle treats database-retry examples as conditional technique (EXC-007); no oracle policy forbids an application-level retry pipeline around ORM operations.
specific_behavior: Wrapping repository calls or SaveChanges in a generic resilience retry pipeline violates the instruction even when the operation is idempotent.

quote: never mutate shared `DefaultRequestHeaders` concurrently
reason: RUN-005 governs client lifetime; thread-safe header handling is client technique that no oracle policy states.
specific_behavior: Setting a per-user access token on DefaultRequestHeaders of a shared typed client per call violates the instruction.

quote: no RC/preview unless explicitly requested
reason: DEP-008 fixes the platform and DEP-023 repository-level build configuration; no oracle policy requires a global.json SDK pin or a specific roll-forward policy.
specific_behavior: A scaffolded solution without global.json, or with a pin that blocks feature-band servicing, deviates from the template.

quote: State that limitation in every report.
reason: WF-020 requires evidence-based contextual severity and WF-009 truthful status reporting; the oracle prescribes no report structure, severity scale or mandatory limitation statement.
specific_behavior: A security review delivered without the limitation statement or the per-layer results table does not follow the procedure.

quote: add the rule once
reason: Instruction-system placement rules; the oracle does not regulate where instruction content is loaded or owned.
specific_behavior: Copying a path-scoped rule into CLAUDE.md for convenience, or restating a rule in a second owner, violates the maintenance procedure.

quote: Unclear case: any "yes" makes it Reserved
reason: GOV-017 requires a Decided/Delegated/Reserved classification but not this test; under it any unclear dependency addition or removal becomes Reserved, whereas the oracle allows dependencies with a concrete need (DEP-001) and delegates routine internal choices (GOV-005).
specific_behavior: An unclear-case addition of a small utility package must go through a Decision Request instead of being added after the add-dependency checks.

quote: <Nullable>enable</Nullable>
reason: DEP-023 places shared settings in Directory.Build.props and DEP-008 fixes the platform; no oracle policy requires nullable reference types or implicit usings.
specific_behavior: Every new project compiles with nullable analysis and implicit global usings, which changes warnings and which using directives count as redundant.

quote: do not mix them casually with tracked entities for the same rows
reason: Imperative inside EF Core bulk-operation technique. Rejected as EXTRA: consistency caveat of an optional technique (EXC-011 class); 'casually' leaves the outcome to judgment.
specific_behavior: none

quote: Never use it for validation failures.
reason: 429 reference entry (EXC-009). Rejected as EXTRA: standard HTTP reference adding no project-specific restriction beyond correct status semantics.
specific_behavior: none

quote: never a generic "nothing changed" business response
reason: 304 reference entry (EXC-009); standard conditional-request semantics, no project-specific restriction.
specific_behavior: none

quote: do not map every dependency failure to `502`
reason: 502 reference entry (EXC-009); clarifies standard gateway semantics only.
specific_behavior: none

quote: never a launch URL pointing to HTTPS on an HTTP-only port
reason: Launch-profile technique (EXC-008); affects local developer launch configuration only.
specific_behavior: none

quote: Use multiple documents only for a real contract separation
reason: Document partitioning is OpenAPI tooling technique (EXC-008); no outcome restriction beyond accurate documentation.
specific_behavior: none

quote: do not test framework internals
reason: Frontend test targeting (EXC-018 detailed test targeting); consistent with behavior-focused testing, no separate restriction.
specific_behavior: none

quote: Integration-test important protected operations
reason: Authorization test targeting is local test technique (EXC-012); rejected as EXTRA because 'important' leaves scope to judgment and no completion gate depends on it.
specific_behavior: none

quote: not a generic data framework for a few objects
reason: Builders/fixtures technique (EXC-012); proportionality guidance already covered by simplicity rules.
specific_behavior: none

quote: never review isolated lines
reason: Review scoping technique (EXC-016 class); supports correctness-focused review, no separate outcome restriction.
specific_behavior: none

quote: Numbers in examples are illustrative, not approved defaults
reason: Clarifies example values in technique code; retry counts and timeouts are internal technical values, not product tunables; no new restriction.
specific_behavior: none

quote: only when compatibility and deployment justify them
reason: Conditional image-size technique (EXC-006).
specific_behavior: none

quote: do not impose a universal `ClockSkew`
reason: Investigation heuristic (EXC-015) limiting false positives; consistent with contextual severity (RULE-L1-0210).
specific_behavior: none

quote: never arbitrary string arrays
reason: Shape guidance for an optional Result pattern whose project-wide adoption is Reserved (RULE-L1-0170); technique of an approval-gated pattern, not registered as EXTRA.
specific_behavior: none

quote: if (state.fingerprint === fingerprint) process.exit(0);
reason: Executable default of the Stop hook: reminders block stopping only once per material change state (fingerprint over reminder kinds and triggering file contents in .claude/.hook-state/stop-state.json); recorded in the exceptions of RULE-L1-0035, RULE-L1-0045, RULE-L1-0044 and EXTRA-L1-0007.
specific_behavior: An unchanged state is not re-blocked; a further change to the same file reminds again.

quote: if (state[key]) {
reason: Branch review: the dependency gate denies a command once and lets the identical command pass within 30 minutes; the hook cannot verify that the add-dependency workflow actually ran. Recorded in the exceptions of RULE-L1-0021 and EXTRA-L1-0010.
specific_behavior: A retried identical install or removal command passes without further checks.

quote: return path.join(activeRoot, '.claude', '.hook-state');
reason: Executable side effect: hooks create .claude/.hook-state/ state files in the active worktree (ignored by .gitignore). Considered as an extra repository change; rejected as non-normative tool state.
specific_behavior: none

quote: the hook does not evaluate MSBuild, so confirm the resolved package is allowed
reason: MSBuild-property package ids and versions are only flagged for manual confirmation; enforcement limitation, not an additional rule.
specific_behavior: none
